description: This file declares the WritableIdentityCredential class, which implements the BnWritableIdentityCredential interface for managing writable identity credentials in Android's hardware identity framework. It includes method declarations for initializing credentials, setting proof sizes, starting personalization, adding access control profiles, and managing credential entries, along with private member variables for internal state management.

classes.name: WritableIdentityCredential
classes.description: A class implementing the BnWritableIdentityCredential interface, providing methods to create and update identity credentials, manage access control profiles, and handle credential entries within Android's hardware identity framework.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Creates the Credential Key. Returns false on failure.

methods.name: initializeForUpdate
methods.description: Prepares the credential for an update with encrypted credential keys. Returns false on failure.

methods.name: getAttestationCertificate
methods.description: Retrieves the attestation certificate chain for the credential.

methods.name: setExpectedProofOfProvisioningSize
methods.description: Sets the expected size of the proof of provisioning.

methods.name: startPersonalization
methods.description: Begins the personalization process with specified access control profiles and entry counts.

methods.name: addAccessControlProfile
methods.description: Adds an access control profile with specified parameters.

methods.name: beginAddEntry
methods.description: Starts adding an entry to the credential with specified access control profiles, namespace, name, and size.

methods.name: addEntryValue
methods.description: Adds a value to the current entry being added.

methods.name: finishAddingEntries
methods.description: Finalizes the addition of entries and outputs credential data and proof signature.
